title: Qt: Make Packet Bytes hover highlighting like Proto Tree, Packet List
description:
Have hover and selected be treated separately. For hovering, use the
same hoverBackground as in the Proto Tree and Packet List, and the
same text foreground. When the selected item is hovered, hovered
takes priority, just like the Proto Tree and Packet List. Hover
highlighting can still be turned off.
   
Fix #20899
Ping #17795
    
AI-Assisted: no
